subject.title: fix(ui): focus composer when starting a new chat

question: Should Control UI own Cmd/Ctrl+N as a global new-chat shortcut, or should this PR limit itself to focusing the composer after existing new-chat actions?
rationale: The code path is focused, but overriding a browser-level shortcut outside editable targets is a product shortcut contract rather than a correctness fact.

options.title: Accept Guarded Cmd/Ctrl+N
options.body: Keep the new global shortcut if maintainers want Control UI to own new-chat creation over the browser shortcut in non-editable app chrome.

options.title: Focus-Only Narrowing
options.body: Limit this PR to composer focus after sidebar/chat-pane new-chat creation and track the global shortcut in the broader guarded-shortcuts work.

options.title: Fold Into Shortcut Dispatcher
options.body: Pause this branch and add Cmd/Ctrl+N through the canonical guarded dashboard shortcut dispatcher when that branch is refreshed.

recommendation.title: Accept Guarded Cmd/Ctrl+N
recommendation.body: Keep the new global shortcut if maintainers want Control UI to own new-chat creation over the browser shortcut in non-editable app chrome.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored this branch and have recent merged sidebar/session work on the same Control UI navigation surface.
